metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for blockchainian's plugins: the feature pipeline (ship, verify, handoff, retro), Codex review/delegation tooling, iOS debugging, profiling, and whole-screen capture on simulator or device, and the Render and Cloudflare plugins carrying only the skills this desk uses.

plugins.name: feature
plugins.description: Ship a feature from a written plan: orchestrate the codex and UX workstreams to a merged, verified, deployed PR, with the UX and UX-verifier agents, the handoff and retro skills, and the no-blocking hooks.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Supervise long-lived codex worker threads on the shared daemon through the codex-manager MCP server: start, prompt, answer, approve, interrupt, get woken, and run codex's review mode over a commit range.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Drive iOS apps from Claude Code: build, run, and inspect on the simulator via XcodeBuildMCP, capture symbolicated ETTrace flamegraphs, root-cause memory leaks from memgraphs, capture whole app screens from a simulator or a connected iPhone, and diff a built screen against a design reference.

plugins.name: render
plugins.description: Deploy, debug, and monitor applications on Render: the Render MCP server over OAuth, the render-assistant agent, the render.yaml validation hook, and the nine Render skills for CLI, Blueprints, debugging, monitoring, env vars, Postgres, Key Value, disks, and MCP setup.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Skills for the Cloudflare developer platform: Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, Wrangler CLI, and web performance, with the five Cloudflare MCP servers.

plugins.name: proxy
plugins.description: Capture and decode the HTTP and WebSocket traffic of a target web or mobile app with mitmproxy: one shared proxy on port 8080 that every session reuses, each capture fanned out to its own file so a read never pays for another capture, WireGuard for phones, and readers for flows, hosts, WebSockets, and shared-domain callers.

plugins.name: intel
plugins.description: Gather and distill knowledge: transcribe audio locally with whisper, digest an article, podcast or video into searchable highlights, translate a whole English EPUB book into a Chinese PDF in the original's format, analyze an app's App Store reviews into a data-driven Chinese doc with charts, and research one creator into a sourced, adversarially reviewed case study PDF.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Inspect and drive web apps from Claude Code: a persistent headless Chromium CLI for scripts and parallel UI probes, find memory leaks by diffing V8 heap snapshots captured over the Chrome DevTools protocol, and check a built page against a design reference.

plugins.name: secrets
plugins.description: Local account credentials, browser sessions and external login adapters.

plugins.name: creator
plugins.description: Run creator accounts: upload a video to the secrets-manager TikTok account through its own Camoufox profile, fetch the account's video stats over time, list the commercial music library's hottest sounds, and open the account's browser for a person to look.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: Claude-only. See the user's desktop without disturbing it: capture one app's window to a PNG while every other window stays where it is.
